text:
Nina: Heads-up from marketplace QA: performance degradation with CUDA 12.5 + driver 542.x on G80 instances. p95 increased and occasional kernel WARN in logs. tagging @Ravi @Ben.
Ravi: Any quick repro and numbers?
Nina: Repro in staged canary:
```
python perf_run.py --model chat-medium --seq 2048 --batch 1
# median=820ms baseline=540ms
# dmesg: "[NVRM] kernel: warning: GPU stall detected"
```
Ben: That kernel warning suggests a driver-side scheduling regression. Partner released 542.1 last week. Suggest immediate marketplace manifest pin to 541.88 for affected images.
partner-liaison: Will notify partner PMs and ask for changelog. Need to know affected regions/images before wide pin.
Nina: Affected lanes: us-east-1 canary, eu-west-1 canary. Proposal:
  1) Create hotfix manifest pinning driver=541.88 and tag images `r-inf-541-pin`
  2) Run perf gate (seq=2048) and require median <650ms
  3) If green, promote to staged and inform partners/customers
ops-bot: Hotfix pipeline triggered (id: hot-453-1).
Ravi: Add rollback snippet and include a test vector in runbook. Also add a telemetry assertion to alert if mem spike > 80%.
Ben: I'll attach kernel changelog and diff once partner shares. Recommend also a short-term fallback runtime flag to avoid the new scheduling path.
partner-liaison: Sent initial note to partner, requested urgent rollback guidance and ETA. Will share partner response here.
Nina: Okay, I'll wait for canary telemetry before drafting customer comms. :white_check_mark:
